expected_outputs.description: Validated review packet template for Review Packet Template.
expected_outputs.name: review_packet_template

implementation_notes: Keep evidence fields stable across tasks so review packets can be compared automatically later.
Do not let screenshots replace commands, tests, or stated risks.
known_failure_modes: Review Packet Template packets omit tests or commands, so review turns into archaeology.
Merge readiness is stated without enough evidence to justify it.
name: Review Packet Template
problem_solved: Standardizes how work built around Review Packet Template is reviewed and handed back.

required_inputs.description: Clear statement of what the completed task aimed to achieve.
required_inputs.name: task_goal

required_inputs.description: Commands, tests, screenshots, or notes captured during execution.
required_inputs.name: evidence_bundle

sections.description: List screenshot evidence or explicitly say none.
sections.name: screenshots

sections.description: State whether the change is ready to merge.
sections.name: merge_recommendation

summary: Standard review packet template for completed Dex or Codex tasks.
when_not_to_use: Do not use when Review Packet Template work is still exploratory and no deliverable boundary exists.
Do not use when the report would repeat richer domain-specific audit artifacts.
when_to_use: Use when work touching Review Packet Template should always return with the same audit fields.
Use when completed Dex tasks need comparable evidence across projects.
